title: Private GND tap guard checker repair using saved native pad geometry

implementation_change.production_geometry: All four private pad global centers and orientations are consumed directly from immutable saved native inventory, keyed by exact UUID. The checker does not use a local-footprint transform to generate pad guards.
implementation_change.shape_and_dimensions: Each native record binds net, pad number, copper layers, orientation, serialized source-pad hash, and native global center. Literal source is independently required to be rect and to match the native serialized dimensions.
implementation_change.absolute_copper: Track and via geometry remains exact absolute source geometry. No track/via coordinates or layer obligations changed.
implementation_change.proposal_identity: Repair-specific UUIDv5 namespace 97546ae5-ecce-54a2-b2d2-719a68f85cb9 avoids reusing the invalid proposal IDs.

native_oracle_controls.interpretation: These are independent source/native identity, global-geometry, and endpoint-contact regressions. They run before guard generation.

guard_contract.existing_source_joins: Preserved by exact immutable source identity; no holes or clipping proposed.

geometry.via: exact outer-copper circle, source diameter/2 + 0.25 mm radius on every spanned conductive layer
geometry.pad: native-center/native-orientation source rectangle with a 0.25 mm Minkowski halo

layer_and_inherited_rule_result.inherited_limit: Existing areas do not establish track, via, pad, footprint, or importer enforcement. BOOST_SW and clock remain separate pending map/placement obligations.
